title: Green Fee-Free Account — summary
summary: This document covers the Green Fee-Free Account: monthly maintenance fee is $22.50 (waiver options available), overdraft fee is $0.00, out-of-network ATM usage (Rho Bank fee) is $0.00, and cashier’s check issuance costs $8 per check.
